title: CTW-adviser · pinned unit evidence inspection
description: Read-only inspection of the pinned CTW-data snapshot, including versioned 1.21.0 packets, spell/activated-ability retrieval, qualified mechanics and opt-in source documentation. Source and packet versions are shown in each unit view.

unit_profiles.description: 2,379 distinct profiles representing 2,409 original unit keys. unit_keys lists equivalent keys; unit_aliases resolves each original key. faction_name is a list; restrictions and source locators remain in unit_availability (3,181 records).

unit_availability.description: Original faction/subculture-qualified availability, restrictions, notes and provenance. Shared inclusion does not transfer recruitment permissions.

unit_aliases.description: All 2,409 original unit keys mapped to canonical profiles. Key-only consolidation requires identical profile fields and linked combat evidence; availability and provenance remain keyed to the original identity.

unit_roster_records.description: Lossless reconstruction of the 3,181 original source roster records; repeated combat statistics are stored once in unit_profiles.

coverage_gaps.description: Known limits in the retained native definitions; these are not inferred combat effects.

source_files.description: Locked source paths and byte hashes used to build this snapshot.

effect_abilities.description: Issue #19: every source-classified spell and activated ability, with stable keys, effect kind (spell = source_type spell/bound), concise derived keywords and definition/casting records. Detailed mechanics stay in the shared native tables.

effect_variants.description: Overcast (overpower_option) and supersession relations between effect identities; status keeps missing or non-activated targets explicit.

effect_access.description: Qualified unit <-> effect links from source unit ability links (culture and effect enabling retained). Not proof of campaign acquisition or of an active effect. Character skill routes are in effect_character_access.

magic_characters.description: 550 indexed characters from CTW-data data/magic (agent subtype, name, class, caster flag).

character_unit_forms.description: Character -> battlefield unit forms by exact main-unit key; unmapped forms stay explicit.

effect_character_access.description: Ability-targeted skill bindings: exact skill/rank, role (enables, enables_overcast, disables, modifies) and status. Conditional possibilities, not selected skills or legality.

magic_skill_bindings.description: All derived skill-effect bindings, including group, phase, unit-set, army and context modifiers that never grant individual spells.

find_units.title: Find units by name
find_units.description: Search by part of a name. Click a unit name to inspect assembled attributes, passive effects, conditions, attacks and provenance.
find_units.sql: select unit_key, unit_name, unit_keys, faction_name, tactical_category, entity_count, total_hp, armour, melee_attack, melee_defence, weapon_base_damage, weapon_ap_damage, speed, multiplayer_cost from unit_profiles where unit_name like '%' || :name || '%' order by unit_name, unit_key

find_effects.title: Find spells and activated abilities
find_effects.description: Search by part of a name, then open effect:<ability_key> at /inspect/detail for mechanics, payload paths and linked units.
find_effects.sql: select ability_key, name, effect_kind, source_type, keywords_json from effect_abilities where name like '%' || :name || '%' order by name, ability_key

find_characters.title: Find characters
find_characters.description: Search by part of a name, then open character:<agent_subtype_key> at /inspect/detail.
find_characters.sql: select agent_subtype_key, character_name, character_class, is_caster, relation_count from magic_characters where character_name like '%' || :name || '%' order by character_name
